title: Playboy Magazine October 1970 First Twin Playmates Collinson William Kunstler
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows toning, edge and corner wear and scattered soiling. The back cover has noticeable soiling and staining along the edges, shown in the photos. Spine intact. No mailing label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, October 1970 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- Playboy's first twin Playmates - Mary and Madeleine Collinson
- Tom Wicker on Richard Nixon
- Pornography and the Danes
- An interview with defense attorney William Kunstler
- Fall & Winter Fashion Forecast
- Your Jazz & Pop Poll Ballot

The twin Playmate cover is the one this issue is remembered for - it was the first time Playboy ran twins as Playmates, and the Collinson sisters went on to appear together in Hammer's "Twins of Evil" the following year.

The back cover carries a 1970 Pall Mall Gold 100's cigarette ad.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
